The checkout and generated WLA overlay remain ignored private research inputs.
No assembly source, comments, bundled assets, ROM-derived data, or generated
overlay is redistributed here.

Local adaptation is limited to the original
`scripts/import_dkc2_symbols.py`, which extracts address/name metadata, and
`scripts/promote_snesrecomp_symbols.py`, which accepts only unambiguous
context-qualified aliases retaining the same generic `CODE_BBXXXX` identity.
Ten such function names were promoted on 2026-08-09. Remaining labels are not
automatically copied or guessed. Public redistribution of derived label
metadata still requires the project's documented provenance/legal review.
